# Generated by `cargo run -p agent_docs` from the diagnostic registry and compiler/tests/ui; do not edit.
title: "W1002 shadowed_import"
description: "A local binding shadows an imported name."
---

A warning from the `resolve` phase. `sakura explain W1002` prints this explanation offline.

A local binding shadows an imported name. This is allowed but often a mistake; rename one.

Warning:

```sakura
import std/retry.{retry}
let retry = 3
```

Fixed:

```sakura
let max_attempts = 3
```

## Wrong program

[`compiler/tests/ui/W1002_shadowed_import.sak`](https://github.com/icantcodefyi/sakuralang/blob/master/compiler/tests/ui/W1002_shadowed_import.sak), which the compiler's ui suite runs through `sakura check`:

```sakura
import std/retry.{retry}

fn attempts() -> Int {
  let retry = 3
  retry
}
```
